structured_output.what_is_happening: A pump.fun coin called ELIZA, created about 17 minutes before detection, migrated to PumpSwap in roughly 8 minutes. Its pitch is that 100% of pump.fun creator rewards go to Shaw (@shawmakesmagic), the developer of ElizaOS/ai16z, through UsePaid. It reached about $105k market cap with $28k of liquidity and has doubled since the pool opened. Buying is broad: 1,061 unique buyers against 681 sellers in 15 minutes. The 5-minute volume rate is about 4.7x the 1-hour average, so the pump is still speeding up. The current price is about 25% below the all-time high of about $140k market cap.

narrative.description: This is a 'creator fees go to a famous dev' coin built on the ElizaOS/ai16z brand, which has well-known AI-agent recognition. It is a known meta: a notable figure gets tagged so he might claim or acknowledge the fees, and any mention from him sets off a pump.
narrative.why_spreading: People recognise the Eliza/ai16z brand, and the fee-routing angle gives them a reason to hope Shaw will engage. The fast migration and the rise in unique buyers show real early interest. Whether it keeps going likely depends on Shaw or ElizaOS accounts reacting, which the packet cannot show.

token_connection.why_this_token: It is the only recent ELIZA launch that migrated and has real volume. It is linked to UsePaid fee routing for @shawmakesmagic, and a DexScreener profile is set up (flagged as a community takeover).
token_connection.competing_tokens: There are two legacy 2024 ELIZA tokens with $100k+ liquidity but no volume, plus about 8 dead same-day ELIZA/ELIZAOS clones worth about $3k each.

authenticity.evidence: Buying looks broad: 1,061 unique buyers, a buy-to-sell ratio of about 1.4, top-10 holders at 18.6%, and snipers holding about 0.2%. The concerns are 79 bundler wallets, 129 fresh wallets (12.9%), and 9.2% held by 'entrapment' traders. The linked X account (cybermyrix) was renamed from real_yazar and has 8 deleted token posts, which suggests a recycled promoter account. The creator has already closed their position. No paid boosts were found.
authenticity.uncertainty: There is no X data, so I cannot tell whether Shaw or ElizaOS have engaged or whether this is only a tweet from a third party.

structural_risks: Creator has exited and the promoter X account looks recycled with deleted token posts
79 bundler wallets and a 9% entrapment-trader share could dump
Two older ELIZA tokens compete for the ticker
The narrative depends on Shaw reacting; a denial or silence kills it
Price is already +100% since the pool opened; the entry chases a 5-minute spike

structured_output.counterargument: Fee-to-famous-dev coins usually peak within the first 30 to 60 minutes and then bleed once the tagged person ignores them or says he has nothing to do with it. Shaw and the ai16z community have seen many such clones. The entry comes right after a +40% 5-minute candle, so a -50% drop is at least as likely as a 2x to about $210k.
unknowns: Whether Shaw or ElizaOS have acknowledged the coin or claimed the fees

structured_output.thesis: This coin sits above the typical coin in the pool. It has a recognisable brand, a meta with upside if Shaw engages, broad buying, clean authorities, burned LP and low holder concentration. Against that, the entry chases a spike, the promoter account looks recycled, bundlers are present and the dev has exited. A 2x is plausible only if Shaw engages.
